title: Wrapped Unconfirmed-PDU seed
purpose: Replace the weak bare tag-only PDU with an ACSE/UserInformation-carried Unconfirmed-PDU so the parser reaches the MMS unconfirmed entry through a realistic wrapper.
expected_behavior: A receiver should accept the ACSE wrapper, reach the MMS layer, and route on tag 0xa3 to unconfirmed-PDU handling.
constraints_preserved: Uses MMS PDU tag 0xa3 for Unconfirmed-PDU.
All BER lengths are definite and matched to content.
Maintains a complete wrapper instead of a raw tag-only fragment.
issue_safety_notes: No issue-based shaping is used; the body stays minimal and length-consistent.
